concerns.text: FR-004 states *"No fallback reduction is permitted; runs exceeding 5.5 hours wall‑clock must be reported and investigated as a performance issue."* This forbids any automatic reduction of work when a run exceeds 5.5 h. Conversely, FR-006 permits a fallback *"if a simulation exceeds 12 hours wall‑clock, reduce the system size by [deferred] while remaining atomistic."* The two requirements overlap because a 12 h simulation also exceeds the 5.5 h threshold, creating a contradictory directive about whether a reduction is allowed. Clarify the scope of FR-004 (e.g., limit it to bootstrap resampling runs) or adjust FR-006 to align with the no‑fallback rule.
